routes.request: Create or review a resume or application packet
routes.target: Riley Morgan · AI orchestrator → Priya Desai · Job search orchestrator → Evidence-led Job Search Playbook
first_reads: Riley Morgan · AI orchestrator routing contract
docs/job-search/application-work-order-template.md for full application-packet artifact, storage, and Template-source rules
Template catalog plus verified rickvang/template-library path, entrypoint, and revision for every reusable application artifact
docs/job-search/job-ledger-contract.md when repeated job discovery or deduplication is in scope
named specialist Persona when the request is narrow rather than full-outcome
non_triggers: Uploading, submitting, contacting an employer, or externally sharing without a separate explicit request
Claiming provider-specific rules without current evidence
Treating Riley Morgan as the Job Search Persona or sole domain expert
Storing private job-search history inside Persona-Library
Treating the Playbook itself as the actor or domain owner
Treating a full application packet as one combined document instead of separate role-folder artifacts
Using a private Drive master as the canonical reusable Template when template-library has not been checked and verified
routes.next_handoff: For unqualified job-search requests, route first through Riley Morgan · AI orchestrator. For unqualified narrow work, Riley routes to the smallest relevant specialist or Skill. For unqualified full-outcome work, Riley routes to Priya Desai · Job search orchestrator, who operates the Evidence-led Job Search Playbook. The Playbook supplies the reusable stages, shared state, handoffs, quality gates, recovery, and learning loop; Priya operates the process and specialists own domain judgment. Explicit specialist or Skill requests route directly to the named target. Explicit Playbook requests route directly to the named Playbook, with Priya as the operating Persona for Evidence-led Job Search. Riley is the default front door, not an unavoidable hop for explicit direct invocation. For a full application packet, resolve every reusable starter through the Template catalog and a verified rickvang/template-library path first; if a required Template is missing, route to Template research/composition and create it in template-library before using it as the reusable starter. Then use the configured private application root, create one role-specific folder, and keep the ATS resume, cover letter, and Application Notes & Answers as separate artifacts by default. Use provider recommendation status and candidate review requirements before selecting an export.
